name: Iodine
effects: Deficiency causes goiter, hypothyroidism, cretinism in children
Excess can paradoxically suppress thyroid (Wolff-Chaikoff effect) or trigger hyperthyroidism in susceptible individuals
Potassium iodide used for radiation emergency thyroid blocking
Hashimoto's thyroiditis patients should be cautious — iodine may exacerbate autoimmunity
Avoid high-dose megadosing protocols popularized online — evidence base is very weak
